# Join with Source5_3_0 on Artist

# Join with Source5_3_1 on Artist
df_final = pd.merge(df_35420, source1, how='outer', on='Artist')

# Group by Artist and aggregate other columns
# According to target schema:
# 'Artist': string (group by)
# 'Year Inducted': float (max to keep latest year)
# 'Years Waited': integer (max)
# '# of Years Nominated': integer (max)
# 'Inducted By': string (max to pick non-null)
# 'Influenced': integer (max)
# 'Certified Units (Millions)': float (max)
# 'Albums in RS500': integer (max)
# 'Top 100 Singles': integer (max)
# 'Highest Position': integer (min) - since lower position is better rank

agg_dict = {
    'Year Inducted': 'max',
    'Years Waited': 'max',
    '# of Years Nominated': 'max',
    'Inducted By': 'max',
    'Influenced': 'max',
    'Certified Units (Millions)': 'max',
    'Albums in RS500': 'max',
    'Top 100 Singles': 'max',
    'Highest Position': 'min'
}

df_grouped = df_final.groupby('Artist', as_index=False).agg(agg_dict)
